1_game.1.8_game_length_note: The game is always exactly 20 turns; no effect extends the game beyond turn 20

3.2_procedure.3.2.1: Lay gameboard on table with space for cards
3.2_procedure.3.2.4: Shuffle remaining diplomacy cards, place face down
3.2_procedure.3.2.6: Each player draws one identity card (becomes home kingdom)
3.2_procedure.3.2.7: Players punch out matching unit counters for their kingdom
3.2_procedure.3.2.8: Remaining identity cards become non-player monarchs
3.2_procedure.3.2.10: Place one personality card face down under each non-player identity card
3.2_procedure.3.2.11: Set aside unused personality cards face down
3.2_procedure.3.2.12: Punch out all non-player kingdom counters
3.2_procedure.3.2.13: Punch out 14 mercenary armies (swords & moneybags) and 6 mercenary fleets (fleets & moneybags)
3.2_procedure.3.2.14: Place turn record indicator on turn 1
3.2_procedure.3.2.15: Place one randomizer chit per player in opaque container
3.2_procedure.3.2.16: Place castle counters on map (excluding basic game exclusions)
3.2_procedure.3.2.17: Place armies and fleets according to starting locations on counters
3.2_procedure.3.2.18: Monarch and ambassador start in royal castle

4.7_castle_counter.4.7.1_description: Represents castle defense and hit points

5_faction_classification.5.1_description: Factions are classified as Human or Non-Human for retreat before combat purposes

6.2_mountain_symbol.6.2.2_mountain_effect: Need not stop in mountain hexes (still pay 3 MP)

6.3_home_kingdom_bonus.6.3.2_effect: Possess both forest and mountain terrain bonuses within home country

7.1.2_procedure.7.1.2.2: Each player draws one without looking
7.1.2_procedure.7.1.2.3: Numbers indicate turn order (1 goes first)
7.1.2_procedure.7.1.2.6: Return to cup before next game turn

7.2_phase_2_player_turns.7.2.1_description: Each player takes turn in determined order

7.2.2_step_A_roll_for_events.7.2.2.1_procedure: Roll 2 dice, consult Random Events Table

7.2.3_step_B_draw_diplomacy_card.7.2.3.1_procedure: Draw top card from diplomacy deck
7.2.3_step_B_draw_diplomacy_card.7.2.3.2_usage: May use immediately or save for later

7.3_phase_3_end_of_turn.7.3.1_procedure: Move turn record indicator forward one space

8.2.1_roll_2.8.2.1.2_effect: Randomly determine which of your friendly non-player monarchs (if any) dies

8.2.2_roll_3.8.2.2.2_effect: Choose and eliminate one of your fleets (if any)

8.2.3_roll_4.8.2.3.2_effect: Choose and eliminate one of your regular or mercenary units

8.2.4_roll_5.8.2.4.2_effect: Regulars of one kingdom won't fight or siege this turn (movement unaffected)
8.2.4_roll_5.8.2.4.3_determination: Random from all player kingdoms and allies

8.2.5_roll_6.8.2.5.2_effect: Bring 2 eliminated regular units back into play
8.2.5_roll_6.8.2.5.3_restriction: Player monarch or allied kingdoms only

8.2.7_roll_8.8.2.7.2_effect: Bring 2 mercenary units (armies or fleets) into play

8.2.8_roll_9.8.2.8.2_effect: Choose and eliminate one of your regular or mercenary units

8.2.9_roll_10.8.2.9.2_effect: Bring 1 regular or mercenary unit into play

8.2.10_roll_11.8.2.10.2_effect: Choose and eliminate one of your mercenary units (if any)

8.2.11_roll_12.8.2.11.2_effect: Randomly determine which neutral non-player kingdom (if any) becomes immediate ally

8.3_rules.8.3.3_blocked_placement: If hex enemy-occupied or under siege, unit cannot enter
8.3_rules.8.3.6_regular_limit: Cannot exceed number on identity card
8.3_rules.8.3.7_immediate_action: All replacements, reinforcements, and monarchs and combat units of kingdoms activated via Help From Afar may move and fight on the same player turn that they appear
8.3_rules.8.3.9_no_transfer: Replacements and reinforcements may not be given to, nor losses taken from, another player except where otherwise indicated (e.g. stealing mercenary units when its pool is depleted)

9_mercenary_units.9.1_description: Mercenary combat units brought into play by Random Events Table
9_mercenary_units.9.2_placement: Any friendly castle or castles (except those currently besieged)
9_mercenary_units.9.3_stacking: May stack with any friendly units - player monarch's own units, allied non-player kingdom units, or Special Mercenary units

9.4_stealing_mercenaries.9.4.1_type_unavailable: If you cannot deploy a mercenary of the remaining type (e.g., only fleets remain in pool and you control no ports), you may declare that mercenaries of the type you want are defecting to your side
9.4_stealing_mercenaries.9.4.2_procedure: Steal mercenary units of the type missing from the recruitment pool directly from an opponent's forces, taking them from their stacks and deploying them into your own valid deployment hexes
9.4_stealing_mercenaries.9.4.3_pool_depleted: If you are due to receive a mercenary unit and all mercenaries are already in play, you may steal units of any type from opponents
9.4_stealing_mercenaries.9.4.4_transport_protection: You cannot steal units from fleets that are transporting enemy troops or characters; having armies in transport protects the mercenary fleet itself from seizure

10.1_friendly_castle_or_port_conditions.10.1.3: Plundered castle/port occupied by at least one friendly combat unit

11_random_determination.11.1_method: When rules call for random determination, roll a die with faces equal to the number of distinct valid options (effectively an n-sided die where n is the number of options)

11.2_examples.11.2.1: Randomly select from 3 allied monarchs = roll 1d3 (or 1d6 with 1-2=first, 3-4=second, 5-6=third)
11.2_examples.11.2.2: Randomly select from available neutral kingdoms = roll die matching count of neutral kingdoms

12.1_general_rules.12.1.1_only_between: Player monarchs and non-player monarchs/special mercenaries/barbarians
12.1_general_rules.12.1.2_player_alliances: Not binding - all player monarchs are enemies
12.1_general_rules.12.1.4_ambassador_movement: Teleports to function location, returns to royal castle after
12.1_general_rules.12.1.5_ambassador_return_blocked: If royal castle enemy-occupied or under siege, returns to player monarch hex or held off map

12.2_diplomatic_die_roll.12.2.1_threshold_comparison: Success requires modified roll >= target number (greater than or equal to)
12.2_diplomatic_die_roll.12.2.2_modification_timing: Diplomacy card played before die roll; modifier applied after roll
12.2_diplomatic_die_roll.12.2.3_modified_result: Final result = die roll + card modifier + personality card modifier - diplomatic penalty (if any)
12.2_diplomatic_die_roll.12.2.4_automatic_success: If modifiers guarantee meeting threshold regardless of roll, success is automatic

12.3.1_activate_neutral_monarch.12.3.1.1_ambassador_placement: Royal castle of neutral non-player monarch

12.3.1.2_procedure.12.3.1.2.2: Optionally play one diplomacy card (card is discarded regardless of outcome)
12.3.1.2_procedure.12.3.1.2.4: Apply modifiers from personality and diplomacy cards

12.3.1.5_success_effect.12.3.1.5.2: Place forces on map at starting locations
12.3.1.5_success_effect.12.3.1.5.3: Forces cannot move or attack until next game turn

12.3.2.2_procedure.12.3.2.2.2: Optionally play one diplomacy card (card is discarded regardless of outcome)

12.3.2.5_success_effect.12.3.2.5.1: Monarch drops out of enemy alliance
12.3.2.5_success_effect.12.3.2.5.2: Forces removed from map after combat portion of current turn
12.3.2.5_success_effect.12.3.2.5.3: Units defend and retreat normally until removed

12.3.2_deactivate_enemy_allied_monarch.12.3.2.6_mercenary_note: Mercenaries stacked with deactivating forces remain under original owner

12.3.3_attempted_assassination.12.3.3.1_limit: Once per game per player monarch
12.3.3_attempted_assassination.12.3.3.5_success_effect: Deactivates monarch and forces (no victory points)
12.3.3_attempted_assassination.12.3.3.6_failure_effect: Ambassador permanently banished from kingdom until monarch dies by other means

12.3.4_duel_enemy_ambassador.12.3.4.1_limit: Once per game between each pair of ambassadors
12.3.4_duel_enemy_ambassador.12.3.4.2_ambassador_placement: In enemy's royal castle where the target ambassador resides

12.4_ambassador_death.12.4.1_effect: Ambassador removed for player's next 2 player turns
12.4_ambassador_death.12.4.2_placement: Counter placed 3 turns ahead on Time Record Track
12.4_ambassador_death.12.4.4_recovery: Successor becomes available on 3rd game turn after death

12.5_banishment.12.5.4_effect: Ambassador may not attempt diplomatic functions on offended monarch/kingdom
12.5_banishment.12.5.6_card_discard_timing: Card is discarded before learning result of die roll; banishment is a consequence of failure, not of card play

12.6_diplomatic_penalty.12.6.1_trigger: Units (except ambassadors) cross border into neutral kingdom
12.6_diplomatic_penalty.12.6.2_effect: -1 to subsequent diplomatic die rolls in violated kingdom
12.6_diplomatic_penalty.12.6.5_deactivation_grace_period: One movement phase to leave or incur penalty
12.6_diplomatic_penalty.12.6.6_voluntary_elimination: Units may be voluntarily eliminated to avoid penalty

13.3.1_diplomatic_ploys.13.3.1.1_description: Grant bonuses to diplomatic die roll

13.3.2_special_mercenary.13.3.2.1_description: Bring special mercenary units into service (Advanced Game only)

13_diplomacy_cards.13.5_trading: May not be traded or exchanged
13_diplomacy_cards.13.6_reshuffle: When deck exhausted, shuffle discard pile
13_diplomacy_cards.13.7_discard_timing: Cards are discarded when used in diplomacy, regardless of success or failure of the diplomatic attempt

14_personality_cards.14.3_reveal: Read aloud when ambassador visits monarch
14_personality_cards.14.4_effects: Bonuses or penalties to diplomatic ploys, movement, combat

15_activating_violated_kingdom.15.1_condition: Placement hexes occupied by enemy combat units
15_activating_violated_kingdom.15.3_unit_placement: Normally and/or adjacent to occupied placement hexes

15.4_siege_on_neutral_castle.15.4.1_effect: Kingdom immediately joins alliance of any other player monarch

16_allied_forces.16.1_movement: Allied forces are moved by the owning player monarch
16_allied_forces.16.2_stacking_restriction: May not stack with forces of any other kingdom
16_allied_forces.16.3_coordination: May conduct sieges, move, and attack at the same time (or in conjunction with) other friendly allied forces and/or forces of the player monarch
16_allied_forces.16.4_allied_castle_entry: Combat units may enter and defend castles of allied kingdoms if the castles are unoccupied by combat units of allied kingdoms
16_allied_forces.16.5_mercenary_stacking: Mercenaries may be stacked with any friendly forces

17.1_requirements.17.1.1_surrounded: Castle surrounded by besieging units or Zones of Siege
17.1_requirements.17.1.3_sufficient_force: Besieging combat units >= defending combat units + intrinsic defense strength

17_sieges.17.2_cooperation_rule: Different players may not combine strengths; separate sieges on same castle possible

17.3_zone_of_siege.17.3.1_extends: One hex around castle in either direction from adjacent combat unit
17.3_zone_of_siege.17.3.2_fleet_restriction: Only extends to all-sea or seashore hexes
17.3_zone_of_siege.17.3.3_land_unit_restriction: Only extends to all-land and seashore hexes

17.4_units_inside_outside.17.4.2_outside_units_must_be: Eliminated or forced to retreat before siege declared
17.4_units_inside_outside.17.4.3_attack_timing: Outside units attacked during combat-resolution phase
17.4_units_inside_outside.17.4.4_retreat_into_castle: Units may retreat before combat into castle
17.4_units_inside_outside.17.4.5_leader_inside_restriction: Cannot add combat bonus to units outside castle
17.4_units_inside_outside.17.4.6_movement_cost: No cost to move in/out of castle
17.4_units_inside_outside.17.4.7_movement_timing: Only during owning player's movement phase or retreat/advance

17.6_declaring_siege.17.6.3_retreat_before_combat_units: Cannot count as besieging until after next movement phase

17.7.2_leaving_siege.17.7.2.1_requirement: Must attack all besieging units first
17.7.2_leaving_siege.17.7.2.3_outcome: Win or lose, survivors may move out through Zone of Siege
17.7.2_leaving_siege.17.7.2.4_movement_after: Full movement allowance, no further attacks
17.7.2_leaving_siege.17.7.2.5_surrounded_castle: Must clear a hex before leaving

17.7.3_attack_from_siege.17.7.3.2_advance_limit: One hex only if all units in hex eliminated
17.7.3_attack_from_siege.17.7.3.3_outside_support: Additional friendly forces outside may join attack
17.7.3_attack_from_siege.17.7.3.4_remain_outside: Attacking units may remain outside, breaking siege

17.8.4_result_6.17.8.4.6_advance: Some, all, or none may advance into castle hex

17.8_resolving_siege.17.8.5_post_siege_restrictions: Units making siege attack cannot otherwise move or attack

17.9_siege_die_roll_modifier.17.9.4_example_1: 15 attackers vs 4 defense + 3 inside = 15 / 7 = 2.14, drop fraction = 2, subtract 1 = +1 modifier
17.9_siege_die_roll_modifier.17.9.5_example_2: 15 attackers vs 4 defense + 4 inside = 15 / 8 = 1.88, drop fraction = 1, subtract 1 = +0 modifier
17.9_siege_die_roll_modifier.17.9.6_example_3: 15 attackers vs 4 defense + 1 inside = 15 / 5 = 3, subtract 1 = +2 modifier

17.10_plundered_castle.17.10.3_royal_castle_note: May continue as diplomacy location if not enemy occupied
17.10_plundered_castle.17.10.4_occupation_effect: Makes castle friendly for mercenary deployment

17.11_fleets_at_sieges.17.11.1_participation: May contribute to attack and defense
17.11_fleets_at_sieges.17.11.3_port_siege_requirement: At least one besieging fleet required
17.11_fleets_at_sieges.17.11.4_zone_coverage: All adjacent all-sea hexes must be covered

17.11.5_seaborne_land_units.17.11.5.1_counting: Counted in siege along with fleets
17.11.5_seaborne_land_units.17.11.5.3_participation: Only in siege combat with besieged forces
17.11.5_seaborne_land_units.17.11.5.4_attack_timing: Only during besieged player's siege phase
17.11.5_seaborne_land_units.17.11.5.5_regular_combat: Not counted during regular combat phase

17.12.1_procedure.17.12.1.2: Attack any one hex of besieging units
17.12.1_procedure.17.12.1.3: Win or lose, may advance into castle hex

17.12.2_surrounded_castle.17.12.2.2_advance_exception: May advance two hexes (into vacated hex, then castle hex)

17.12_relieving_forces.17.12.3_post_relief: Forces may remain outside or go inside

17.13_forced_peace.17.13.1_trigger: Allied royal castle plundered and occupied
17.13_forced_peace.17.13.6_contested_modifier: If dispossessed alliance attacked occupying forces last turn, only 6 succeeds
17.13_forced_peace.17.13.8_alternative: May use normal diplomacy to deactivate instead (no forced peace roll)

17.13.9_effects.17.13.9.2_during_forced_peace: No ambassadors may work diplomacy in kingdom
17.13.9_effects.17.13.9.3_unit_removal: Remove all units at end of current player turn
17.13.9_effects.17.13.9.4_card_return: Identity and Personality cards returned to neutral pool
17.13.9_effects.17.13.9.5_monarch_availability: Place counter on time record track for availability turn

17.13_forced_peace.17.13.11_unit_status: Only regulars alive at deactivation will set up if reactivated

18.1_general_rules.18.1.1_who_moves: Only player whose turn it is
18.1_general_rules.18.1.4_minimum_movement: Any unit may always move at least one hex

18.3_which_units_may_not_move.18.3.2: Units of kingdom that just activated
18.3_which_units_may_not_move.18.3.3: Units of kingdom that just deactivated

18.5_restrictions.18.5.1_enemy_hex: Cannot enter hex with enemy unit
18.5_restrictions.18.5.2_allied_stacking: Cannot end turn in same hex as different allied kingdom
18.5_restrictions.18.5.4_terrain_cost_exceeded: Cannot enter hex if terrain cost exceeds remaining MP
18.5_restrictions.18.5.5_land_sea_boundaries: Land units cannot cross all-sea hexsides; fleets cannot cross all-land hexsides
18.5_restrictions.18.5.6_off_map: Cannot voluntarily move off map; forced off = eliminated

19.2_forest.19.2.2_special_movement: Units with tree symbol treat as clear

19.4_major_river.19.4.1_crossing_requirement: Must begin movement phase in hex
19.4_major_river.19.4.3_crossing_definition: A land unit crossing of a major river is defined as moving from one major river hex to another major river hex, without a common neighbour that is neither a major river, sea, or lake

19.5_hills.19.5.2_special_movement: Units with mountain symbol treat as clear

19.6_mountains.19.6.4_special_movement: Units with mountain symbol need not stop (still pay 3 MP)

19.7_lakeshore.19.7.3_lakeshore_crossing_exception: A land unit does not cross the lakeshore if it moves from one lakeshore hex to another lakeshore hex, and both lakeshore hexes have a mutual neighbour that is neither a sea, major river or a lake

19.8_seashore.19.8.4_seashore_crossing_exception: A land unit does not cross the seashore if it moves from one seashore hex to another seashore hex, and both seashore hexes have a mutual neighbour that is neither a sea, major river or a lake

19.11_isle_of_fright.19.11.2_restriction: Fleets may only enter if effecting rescue

19.12_mountain_pass.19.12.2_combat_effect: Defending units doubled in combat value

19.16_scenic_hex.19.16.3_terrain_icons: Where terrain icons are included, apply those terrain effects (e.g., Willowik <L19> contains both forest and hills)
19.16_scenic_hex.19.16.4_basic_game_access: Units may end movement in scenic hexes

20_ports.20.1_definition: Seashore hexes enterable by both vessels and land units

20.2_castle_ports.20.2.7_example: Groat is just a castle, not a castle-port; Adeese (Shucassam's palace) is a castle-port

20_ports.20.4_mercenary_fleet_deployment: May deploy at friendly non-castle port

21.3_restrictions.21.3.2_allied_fleet_stacking: Cannot end movement in same hex
21.3_restrictions.21.3.3_seashore_with_enemy_land: May move through, cannot end there
21.3_restrictions.21.3.4_lone_monarch_seashore: No leader fate die roll when passing through

22_sea_transport.22.6_fleet_continuation: May continue moving, embarking, debarking until MP spent

24.5_allied_castle_entry.24.5.1_condition: Castle unoccupied by combat units of allied kingdoms

24_stacking.24.6_examination: Any player may examine opponent's stacks at any time

25.2_retreat_before_combat.25.2.1_timing: After attack declared, before dice rolled
25.2_retreat_before_combat.25.2.3_stack_test_order: Test unit with least chance first; success allows all to retreat
25.2_retreat_before_combat.25.2.4_retreat_destination: Adjacent hex not occupied by enemy
25.2_retreat_before_combat.25.2.5_same_hex_retreat: All units must retreat to same hex
25.2_retreat_before_combat.25.2.6_displacement: May displace friendly allied units if only option
25.2_retreat_before_combat.25.2.8_no_place_swap: Two stacks may not simply trade places
25.2_retreat_before_combat.25.2.9_no_retreat_if: Completely surrounded by enemy combat units
25.2_retreat_before_combat.25.2.10_second_retreat: Not allowed if still adjacent to attacking units
25.2_retreat_before_combat.25.2.11_attacker_advance: May advance into vacated hex, no further attacks

25.3_resolution.25.3.4_tie_losses: Both sides lose units equal to the tied die result
25.3_resolution.25.3.5_loss_selection: Owning player chooses which units eliminated

25.4_combat_die_roll_modifier.25.4.4_minimum_defender_bonus: +1 is the minimum (floor) when defenders outnumber attackers; the formula result is used if higher than +1

25.5_attack_declaration.25.5.1_timing: All attacks stated before any resolved

25.7.1_may_attack.25.7.1.1: Units of player whose turn it is
25.7.1_may_attack.25.7.1.2: Replacements and reinforcements entered this turn

25.7.2_may_not_attack.25.7.2.1: Units that declared/made siege attack this turn
25.7.2_may_not_attack.25.7.2.2: Land units aboard fleets (except siege combat)
25.7.2_may_not_attack.25.7.2.3: Units of kingdom activated this turn
25.7.2_may_not_attack.25.7.2.4: Units of kingdom deactivated this turn

25.8_target_restrictions.25.8.1_may_attack: Any adjacent enemy units except those inside castles

25.10_attack_limits.25.10.2_hex_attack_limit: Once per player turn by each player
25.10_attack_limits.25.10.3_multiple_player_attacks: Same hex may be attacked by different players on their turns

25.12_multiple_unit_combat.25.12.1_stack_attack_rule: If any unit attacks, all must attack
25.12_multiple_unit_combat.25.12.2_split_attacks: Units in stack may attack different adjacent hexes
25.12_multiple_unit_combat.25.12.3_all_defenders_attacked: All units in hex attacked as single total

25.13_advance_after_combat.25.13.2_units_advancing: Some, all, or none of attacking units

26.3_leader_movement_bonus.26.3.1_applies_to: One stack containing own regulars and/or mercenaries
26.3_leader_movement_bonus.26.3.2_effect: Stack uses leader's movement allowance and terrain bonuses
26.3_leader_movement_bonus.26.3.3_requirement: Units must begin and end turn stacked with leader
26.3_leader_movement_bonus.26.3.4_partial_movement: Units may be added/left behind during move
26.3_leader_movement_bonus.26.3.5_independent_movement: Units using leader-assisted movement cannot move independently
26.3_leader_movement_bonus.26.3.6_terrain_transfer: Unit terrain bonuses do not transfer to leader

26.4_leader_combat_bonus.26.4.2_stacking_bonuses: Multiple leader bonuses may be combined

26.6.1_triggers.26.6.1.1: Units in leader's stack lost in combat
26.6.1_triggers.26.6.1.2: Lone leader passes through enemy stack
26.6.1_triggers.26.6.1.3: Enemy stack passes through lone leader's hex
26.6.1_triggers.26.6.1.4: Castle containing leader falls to siege
26.6.1_triggers.26.6.1.5: Leader attempts to leave besieged castle alone
26.6.1_triggers.26.6.1.6: Fleet containing leader lost at sea

26.6.4_exceptions.26.6.4.1_advance_on_eliminated_stack: Only one roll (not additional for advance)

26.6_leader_fate_die_roll.26.6.5_enemy_forcing_roll: Any non-fleet unit may enter lone leader's hex

26_leaders.26.7_lone_leader_rule: Cannot be attacked (only fate rolls and assassination)

27_leader_adrift_at_sea.27.1_trigger: Leader without fleet on open sea (combat or events)
27_leader_adrift_at_sea.27.3_no_enemy_fleet_present: Immediately placed on Isle of Fright
27_leader_adrift_at_sea.27.4_while_on_isle: -1 on all combat and siege rolls for monarch's troops
27_leader_adrift_at_sea.27.6_enemy_capture: Not possible at Isle of Fright
27_leader_adrift_at_sea.27.9_diplomacy: Ambassadors may work on castaway monarch

28.1.3_during_confusion.28.1.3.3_at_turn_end: Remove all units from map, place on identity card
28.1.3_during_confusion.28.1.3.4_monarch_counter: Place on Time Record Track for availability turn
28.1.3_during_confusion.28.1.3.5_diplomacy: No ambassador may work in kingdom

28.1.4_end_of_confusion.28.1.4.1_new_monarch: Draw new personality card (face down under identity)

28.1_non_player_monarch_death.28.1.6_eliminated_regulars: Remain eliminated (only replaced via Random Events)

28.2_player_monarch_death_or_capture.28.2.6_potential_win: Eliminated player can win if highest points

28.2.7_reentry_option.28.2.7.1_timing: Turn after elimination (if there is one)
28.2.7_reentry_option.28.2.7.3_selection: Randomly from available non-player kingdoms (not in confusion)

28.3_non_player_monarch_capture.28.3.1_prison_placement: Nearest unbesieged castle controlled by captor

28.3.4_prisoner_status.28.3.4.2_actions: Incapable of offensive or defensive action
28.3.4_prisoner_status.28.3.4.3_garrison: Castle intrinsic defense serves as garrison

28.3.5_release_conditions.28.3.5.1: Successful siege of prison castle by prisoner's own/allied troops

28.3_non_player_monarch_capture.28.3.6_release_placement: Nearest unplundered, unbesieged friendly castle (or nearest friendly unit)

28.4_executing_prisoner.28.4.1_timing: Immediately upon capture or any subsequent diplomacy phase
28.4_executing_prisoner.28.4.2_victory_points: None for execution (capture points already awarded)
28.4_executing_prisoner.28.4.3_penalty: Permanent diplomatic penalty in slain monarch's kingdom

28.5_forcing_peace_on_prisoner.28.5.1_timing: Each turn during jailer's diplomacy phase
28.5_forcing_peace_on_prisoner.28.5.4_siege_modifier: If prison castle besieged by prisoner's forces/allies, only 6 succeeds
28.5_forcing_peace_on_prisoner.28.5.6_alternative: Normal diplomacy on captive (uses ambassador, cards apply)

29_victory_conditions.29.1_determination: Victory is determined by a system of Victory Points
29_victory_conditions.29.2_timed_victory: The player who amasses the most points after 20 turns is the winner, the player with the second highest total comes in second, and so on

29.4_scoring_notes.29.4.6_posthumous_victory: Eliminated player can win if highest points

30.1_trolls.30.1.1_setup: Four separate locations: Stone Face (capital), The Gathering, The Crag, The Shunned Vale
30.1_trolls.30.1.2_no_castles: Troll locations are cities without castles. They have no intrinsic defense strength and cannot be besieged in the traditional sense. Enemy units may freely enter Troll locations.
30.1_trolls.30.1.3_monarch_start: The Troll monarch starts at Stone Face (col 6, row 13)

30.1.4_regeneration.30.1.4.4_placement_blocked: If hex enemy occupied, cannot regenerate that turn
30.1.4_regeneration.30.1.4.5_same_turn_loss: Regular lost through Random Events cannot regenerate same turn

30.2.1_nithmere_mountains_deployment.30.2.1.2_location: Mountain and pass hexes of Zorn territory

30.2.1.7_example_deployment.30.2.1.7.1_note: This is one valid deployment; other configurations meeting the rules are permitted

30.3_dwarves.30.3.3_unity: All related, fight for common cause

31_cities_vs_castles.31.1_distinction: Not all faction cities are castles. Units always deploy from cities, but only cities with castle markers provide intrinsic defense.

31.2_cities_without_castles.31.2.2_effect: These locations serve as deployment hexes but have no intrinsic defense and cannot be besieged

31.3_castle_locations.31.3.1_identification: Hexes with 'castle: true' terrain marker in hexmap
31.3_castle_locations.31.3.2_defense: Provide intrinsic defense strength for siege rules
